newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus police detain U.S. players after assault.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus police detain U.S. players after assault.

text.p: Five Americans, four of them players with first division basketball teams in Cyprus, were detained on Thursday on suspicion of knocking a policeman unconscious during a fight, police said.
A police spokesman said the Americans were arrested at a cafeteria in the capital Nicosia earlier in the day as they fought with the off-duty policeman and others who joined in the brawl.
"The policeman was attacked by the five foreigners when he demanded explanations from one of them who was pestering his girlfriend," the spokesman said.
A district court later ordered their remand for five days.
Sources said representatives of the U.S. embassy would be visiting the suspects in detention on Friday.
The policeman, an officer in the anti-terrorist unit, was taken to hospital in a comatose condition where he was diagnosed as having a head injury. He is being kept in for further treatment.
